scope: Independent source review and frozen controlled browser tests; fake browser peers, media leaves and timers. No provider calls or real ICE connectivity checks were made by this review.

review.checks: Current offer and answer candidates can proceed at the existing gathering deadline. Candidate-free pending gathering rejects. A connected microphone is required for input_ready; connected receiver and track are required for playback_ready. End and generation replacement reject before and immediately after the deadline. Wait listeners and timers are removed.
review.reference_difference: The official example uses a 10,000ms deadline. This fix retains the application’s existing 8,000ms deadline and changes only whether present candidates may attempt connectivity. Neither setting is a performance acceptance target.
review.complete_state_limit: As in the official helper and existing application, iceGatheringState complete ends the gathering wait directly. Candidate-free timeout tests cover pending gathering. Subsequent connection and media checks remain required in every path.
